mapper.update: UPDATE expense_partial_adjustment_return SET active_funds_identity=NULL,released_at=#{at} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND adjustment_id=#{id} AND released_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM finance_consumption_reduction WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND adjustment_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND adjustment_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_partial_adjustment_return SET completed_at=#{updatedAt},completed_version=#{version} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND adjustment_id=#{id} AND completed_at IS NULL AND released_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_report_id=#{report}
SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{report} AND completed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY completed_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{report} ORDER BY sequence_no,created_at,id
SELECT funds_identity FROM expense_partial_adjustment_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{report} AND active_funds_identity IS NOT NULL
SELECT state_json FROM expense_partial_adjustment_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND adjustment_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.report_id,q.version,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM expense_partial_adjustment q LEFT JOIN expense_report report ON report.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND report.id=q.report_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=report.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=q.round_no WHERE q.status='READY' AND q.completed_at IS NULL AND q.retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY q.updated_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT entry_json FROM expense_partial_adjustment_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_id=#{reportId} AND active_funds_identity=#{fundsIdentity} AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT id FROM expense_partial_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_id=#{reportId} AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND status<>'APPLIED' LIMIT 1
SELECT sequence_no FROM expense_partial_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND report_id=#{reportId} AND completed_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.before_version,c.after_version,c.source_json,c.completed_at,b.state_json AS before_json,a.state_json AS after_json FROM expense_partial_adjustment_completion c JOIN expense_partial_adjustment_revision b ON b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.adjustment_id=c.adjustment_id AND b.version=c.before_version JOIN expense_partial_adjustment_revision a ON a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND a.adjustment_id=c.adjustment_id AND a.version=c.after_version WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.adjustment_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND adjustment_id=#{adjustmentId} AND side=#{side}

choose.when: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.id,a.report_id,a.version,o.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id,a.budget_operation_id AS operation_id FROM expense_partial_adjustment a LEFT JOIN expense_partial_adjustment_operation o ON o.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND o.adjustment_id=a.id AND o.id=a.budget_operation_id LEFT JOIN expense_report report ON report.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND report.id=a.report_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND business.id=report.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=a.round_no WHERE a.retired_at IS NULL AND ((a.budget_status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND a.budget_next_at<=#{parameters[0]}) OR (a.budget_status IN ('EXECUTING','POSTING','QUERYING') AND a.budget_lease_until<=#{parameters[1]})) ORDER BY a.updated_at,a.id LIMIT 10
choose.otherwise: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.id,a.report_id,a.version,o.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id,a.accrual_operation_id AS operation_id FROM expense_partial_adjustment a LEFT JOIN expense_partial_adjustment_operation o ON o.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND o.adjustment_id=a.id AND o.id=a.accrual_operation_id LEFT JOIN expense_report report ON report.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND report.id=a.report_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND business.id=report.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=a.round_no WHERE a.retired_at IS NULL AND ((a.accrual_status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND a.accrual_next_at<=#{parameters[0]}) OR (a.accrual_status IN ('EXECUTING','POSTING','QUERYING') AND a.accrual_lease_until<=#{parameters[1]})) ORDER BY a.updated_at,a.id LIMIT 10
